hypothesis: frozen Top-5 candidates can be better ranked with neighboring token roles and box geometry
candidate_policy: reorder only candidates already present inside one declared homograph family

model.inner_selection: formula-disjoint strict macro then micro accuracy

features.context: emission plus adjacent predicted tokens/roles and sequence position
features.context_geometry: context plus bbox, stroke, direction, and neighbor offsets

crohme.scope: CC BY-NC research-only; five formula-disjoint folds; never a product model

limitations: The direct set has three writers and no O, o, or vertical-bar truth labels.
This is an exploratory dataset already inspected during model development, not an untouched final acceptance set.
Truth grouping is supplied; grouping and formula decoding are not evaluated here.
